initialExam.title: UPSC NDA & NA (I) Examination 2026
initialExam.description: National Defence Academy and Naval Academy exam for entry into Army, Navy, and Air Force wings of NDA and Naval Academy. NDA I 2026 exam conducted on April 12, 2026.
initialExam.qualifications: 12th pass with Physics & Math for Navy/Air Force
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: Mathematics (300 marks). Paper-II: General Ability Test - English (200 marks) + General Knowledge (400 marks).
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 120 questions, 300 marks, 2.5 hours. Paper-II: 150 questions, 600 marks, 2.5 hours. SSB Interview: 900 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → SSB Interview (5 days) → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Cadet at NDA (Army/Navy/Air Force wing) or Naval Academy
initialExam.careerGrowth: Lieutenant → Captain → Major → Colonel → Brigadier → Major General → Lt General → General.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Appear for exam
initialExam.perks: Free training, Accommodation, CSD canteen, Medical, Pension, Adventure activities
